Description.SourceString:
A shield of obsidian, forged and reforged countless times in the heart of the Elder Kiln. Aeons of experience defending against anything that might seek to do its bearer harm, this shield now stands as one of the sturdiest defences on the planet.

Yet, within this shield, are myriad cracks and fractures, imperceptible to the human eye, yet strained across the entire structure, down to its core. A last cry of the desperate KotHaar that wielded it, as their will was subverted by the dragon Fuzan and turned to cruelty.

If you were to gaze upon those fractures with the eyes of the KotHaar you would see a warning to all. Beware the fire, fear the sun, she whispers through the luminance from worlds of kindling ash.
